replies: Visitors are welcome on the general wards every day from 11 in the morning to 8 in the evening. Two visitors at a time can be at the bedside. One family member or caregiver can stay outside these hours if the care team agrees. Is there anything else I can help with?

results.label: faq
replies: The visitor garage is under the Main Building, entered from Harbourview Road. Parking is 4 dollars for each half hour, up to 20 dollars a day; a weekly pass costs 50 dollars at the information desk. You pay at the machines by the elevators. Is there anything else I can help with?

results.label: faq
replies: Lakeside General Hospital is at 100 Harbourview Road. The main entrance is on Harbourview Road; the bus stops right outside, and the nearest subway station is a five-minute walk. Is there anything else I can help with?

results.label: faq
replies: Clinics are in the Main Building. Level 1 has the fracture clinic and the pre-admission clinic. Level 2 has the blood thinner (anticoagulation) clinic and the general surgery clinic. Level 3 has the cardiology and heart function clinics. Level 4 has respirology, and Level 5 the stroke prevention clinic. Is there anything else I can help with?
